articles.summary: Damar Hamlin is joining Under Armour as a brand ambassador, bringing his passion for community impact to the brand's continued efforts to support the next generation of athletes. Hamlin will represent the brand as the athlete ambassador for Protect This Mind, UA’s new mental wellness initiative designed to help student-athletes access trusted resources, build stronger support systems and develop skills that support lifelong wellbeing.
articles.title: Damar Hamlin Joins Under Armour as Brand Ambassador, Championing Mental Wellness for the Next Generation

articles.summary: With a second-place finish at the 2026 Chicago Marathon, Lokedi secured the seventh Abbott World Marathon Major podium of her career, crossing the finish line in 2:14:07 against one of the deepest and most competitive fields assembled this season. The result further cements her position among the world's elite marathoners and continues a remarkable run of success across the sport's biggest stages.
articles.title: Sharon Lokedi Captures Seventh Abbott World Marathon Major Podium in Chicago

articles.summary: Under Armour brought together England and Saracens rugby captain Maro Itoje and Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta in North London for an exclusive meeting between two champions exploring the mindset, resilience and leadership required to perform at the highest level.
articles.title: Maro Itoje Meets Mikel Arteta: Two Leaders, Two Mindsets, Two Champions

articles.summary: Under Armour is celebrating the sport where the brand began with, We Love Football, a season-long content platform celebrating the passion that make football one of America's most beloved sports.
articles.title: Under Armour Debuts We Love Football Campaign

articles.summary: Under Armour today announced Protect This Mind, a mental wellness initiative building on the brand’s work with high school student-athletes through Project Rampart. With NFL professional football player Damar Hamlin serving as its athlete ambassador, the platform brings together free mental wellness resources, peer-to-peer support, and expert-backed training for coaches and educators to better help young athletes navigate the pressures of sport, school and everyday life.
articles.title: Under Armour Launches "Protect This Mind," A New Mental Wellness Initiative for Student Athletes, Alongside Athlete Ambassador Damar Hamlin

articles.summary: Under Armour officially opened the doors to its first Montana retail location on September 18, welcoming customers and community members to the Bozeman Sports House at Gallatin Crossing.
articles.title: UNDER ARMOUR OPENS FIRST MONTANA STORE, INTRODUCES NEW RETAIL CONCEPT IN BOZEMAN

articles.summary: Northwestern University Athletics and Under Armour (NYSE: UA) today announced a landmark 10-year extension of their apparel and equipment partnership, keeping the Wildcats outfitted by the Baltimore-based global performance brand through at least 2037. The agreement extends the current contract set to expire in 2027 and represents the most comprehensive and forward-looking apparel partnership in Northwestern Athletics history.
articles.title: Northwestern Athletics and Under Armour Announce Landmark 10-Year Partnership Extension Through 2037

articles.summary: AMHERST, Mass. – Massachusetts Athletics and Under Armour are excited to announce an eight-year partnership, making the brand the official outfitter and supplier for UMass’ 21 varsity sport programs and athletics staff. Beginning on July 1, 2027, Under Armour will become the exclusive provider of uniforms, apparel, footwear and accessories.
articles.title: Massachusetts Athletics and Under Armour Announce Long-term Apparel Partnership

articles.summary: Launching RaKai’s first-ever footwear collaboration with UA, called the 25XX — RaKai’s exclusive interpretation of the UA Arc 96. UA's Full Access with RaKai social series has given fans a front row seat to the Twitch star’s journey as a UA brand ambassador — from taking over the main stage at Rolling Loud to stepping inside the boardroom, now creating his footwear collaboration.
articles.title: RaKai and Under Armour Take Their Partnership to the Next Level With the Launch of the UA Arc 96 “25XX”

articles.summary: Rebel Daughter reflects Under Armour and Feng Chen Wang's shared understanding of contemporary women's strength. It is a strength expressed not only through speed, power and performance, but also through the confidence to challenge convention and embrace change. Rooted in tradition yet unbound by it, these women carve out their own paths without seeking to fit in or be defined. Different by nature and connected by choice, they rise together as Rebel Daughters
articles.title: Under Armour and Feng Chen Wang Bring Rebel Daughter to China, Celebrating the Power of Modern Women

articles.summary: — CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield (CareFirst), one of the region's largest not-for-profit healthcare organizations, announced earlier this week a new partnership with Under Armour through Project Rampart, a youth development initiative started by Under Armour dedicated to elevating the student-athlete experience and improving academic outcomes through sport, mentorship and academic support.
articles.title: CareFirst and Under Armour Partner to Advance Youth Health and Well-Being Across Baltimore and Washington, DC
